product_metadata.title: Isaac Jacobs Glittered Decorative Jewel Picture Frame, Photo Display & Home Décor (4x4)
features: APPEALING LOOK: Turn heads with this gorgeous frame! With its glitz and glamour, this radiant frame is sure to put a twinkle in your eyes. This elegant picture frame keeps your snapshots and artwork looking great. The ornate detailed frame makes a fabulous home for your cherished memories and it is uniquely designed to hold your perfect Kodak moment. Turn your posed portraits, artful prints and favorite milestones into a spectacular display

FRAME DESIGN: This clean and classy design adds sophistication and sparkle to your home décor whether on a desk, shelf, coffee table, living room, or dining room. Its shimmering glittery look brightens your photos to enhance your lovely precious moments. This Isaac Jacobs International decorative picture frame is very stylish and easy to use

GREAT GIFTS FOR: Wedding, Anniversary, Engagement, Baby and Bridal showers, Graduation, Birthday present, Christmas, Valentine’s day, Mother’s Day, House Warming, or any other special occasion. The glitter beads border around the glass is perfect for friends, family, or a special loved one
ORIENTATION: Can be placed in landscape or portrait orientation. Two-way easel allows for vertical or horizontal display. Does NOT hang on wall.
DIMENSIONS: Fits a 4x4 photo. Overall frame size is 5.25” by 5.25” (inches)
description: This decorative glitzy picture frame brings out the memory in each photo with its extravagant stones. The glamorous dazzling frame lightens up your home or office décor. Can be placed on any flat surface such as your desk, vanity, kitchen counter, coffee table, office desk, night stand and more. Your remarkable photos deserve to be in a very special place! Our picture frames are made to ensure and enhance your most precious memories in a sparkling way. There is no better way to shine the light on your favorite days. Weddings, Engagements etc. BE DAZZLED with this frame. Romance is in the air!
